published_source: Published article (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2025.02515.txt, Table 4, column (2) Retail-to-Online Access, row Pr(Cons. Loan)): -0.000084 (0.000081). published_coef is the authors' code.R re-run on the package data (did::att_gt dr, notyettreated, varying base, weights num_individs_2015, cluster county; aggte type 'simple', min_e = -8, max_e = 16), deterministic, and rounds to the printed value. published_se is the article's bootstrap SE; the analytical SE of the re-run is in authors_rerun_se_analytic. Checked Nov 2 2026 (meta-3).
notes: Retail-to-Online Access design: gvar online_treat_time = quarter online/mobile betting launched (0 = retail-only, never online). Sample = authors' rto_main_subset flag (counties in states that first had retail betting; 1,576 counties, quarters 9-30, N = 20,837). 13 online cohorts (11,12,14,15,16,18,21,23,24,25,27,28,29); 498 never-online counties; no always-treated counties. Authors report Callaway-Sant'Anna (did::att_gt, control_group = 'notyettreated', est_method = 'dr', base_period = 'varying', allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, xformla = ~1, weightsname = 'num_individs_2015', clustervars = county, bstrap = TRUE without a seed). No TWFE regression exists in the package; the TWFE counterpart is D = 1[gvar > 0 & time >= gvar] with county FE + quarter FE, weights num_individs_2015, clustered by county. Treatment never switches off (defined from a unit-constant timing variable). Outcome levels were additively transformed by the authors to hide actual levels (README); county IDs anonymized; underlying UC Consumer Credit Panel is restricted. published_coef is the authors' code re-run on the package data and matches the article's printed value (Nov 2 article check); published_se is the article's bootstrap SE. Project member Davide Proserpio is a coauthor (PROTOCOL Section 6). CAVEAT: the RTO sample is an unbalanced panel with counties entering at their state's retail launch; did with allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE uses repeated-cross-section 2x2 cells whose control composition changes between g-1 and t, which drives the authors' and the pipeline's CSA estimates (see replication log, 'composition-driven' section). TWFE and BJS are unaffected. Nov 2 audit: drop_e_above = 16 reproduces the authors' aggte(max_e = 16) window: treated rows with rel > 16 (cohorts adopting in the first quarters of the window, observed beyond 16 quarters) are dropped for all three estimators, so TWFE and imputation use the same treated cells as the published CSA number; the control pool is unchanged.
csa_weights_note: Nov 2: the published CSA comes from R did (or staggered, whose estimates did reproduces), which weights cells by fixed cohort shares; Hull's DiD-averaging weights cells by treated-observation counts. 'did' reproduces the published number (main analysis, option B); the strict-Hull run (CSA_STRICT_HULL=1, option A) ignores this field.
